items.headline: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq slip as AI safety concerns and US-Iran tensions resurface
items.summary: U.S. stock futures moved lower as renewed US-Iran tensions and AI-safety concerns pressured risk sentiment ahead of a data-heavy week. Dow futures fell 0.3%, S&P 500 futures declined 0.4%, and Nasdaq-100 futures dropped 0.9%; Brent crude rose to about $98 per barrel after President Trump rejected Tehran’s proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
